Make a client theme

Copy theme.example.css to theme.css: a primary colour, an accent and a neutral hue is enough. Or paste a block from the daisyUI theme generator. Every theme has both modes: data-mode="dark" or "light" on <html> picks the other version (generated from the theme's own colours). Use the Natural / Light / Dark switch above to preview them.
